notes.title: v2.0.0 - 25th July Major Update + 20% Sale
notes.content:
[p][i]Hey! Today's update is our first major update to the game, adding new content and fixing more bugs![/i] 
 [/p][h3][b]What's new?[/b][/h3][p][b]Pets:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 4 new cats styles[/p][/*][*][p]Added 4 new dog styles[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new pet type - chickens![/p][/*][*][p]Added 4 chicken styles[/p][/*][/list][p] 
[b]Misty's Boat:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 4 new flags[/p][/*][*][p]Added 4 new cargo decorations[/p][/*][*][p]Added 4 new boat details  
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Misty:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 4 new hair styles[/p][/*][/list][h3][b] 
Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Changed UI to say "birds" instead of "parrots" [/p][/*][*][p]Refactored the sound system for pets to allow each one to have a unique sound (not all do right now though)[/p][/*][*][p]Removed some unused assets which should help to reduce the game's file size [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]
Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed Misty continuing to fish after switching islands [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed certain UI menus and elements staying open after switching islands [/p][/*][/list][h3][b] 
20% Sale[/b][/h3][p]To celebrate our first major update we're putting the game on sale for 20%. 

[i]Thank you for all your support![/i][/p]

notes.title: v1.1.0 - July 19th Update
notes.content:
[p]This update improves upon the currency conversion menu to make it more convenient for players to use, especially in the later game where you may need to convert large amounts of points at once.  

[b]Changes:[/b] 
- Added more options to control the amount of currency you are converting  
- Added an "ALL" option 
- Added a "RESET" option  

[b]Fixes: 
[/b]- Fixed font outline to be more consistent with other UI elements (this also makes it more readable!)

Another patch is coming soon which will fix some more bugs. If you encounter a bug, please report it to us using the steam discussion page!

[b]Thanks for playing <3[/b][/p]

notes.title: v1.0.1 - July 8th Patch
notes.content:
[p]Today's patch brings a couple of bug fixes

[b]Fixes[/b]:
- Fixed mistype of values in some upgrade descriptions[/p][p]- Fixed some spelling mistakes in titles and descriptions[/p][p]- Fixed minigame indicator going under name label[/p][p]- Fixed fish catch values on later islands not being in-line with the rest of the game

Thanks to everyone who has reported bugs! Keep them coming :)

[/p]

notes.title: Misty's Idle Fishing OUT NOW!
notes.content:
